data.content: Not destroyed, but merely… deferred. The world shimmered, then slipped away.

Task:
Write a short flavor text for a custom Magic: The Gathering card.

Card name: Semigeddon
Mana cost: 3W
Type: Sorcery
Rules text: Put a phasing counter on each land.

Theme: Land destruction reimagined as phasing — lands flicker out of existence
rather than being destroyed outright. A gentler apocalypse.


The flavor text should:
- Evoke the feeling of lands phasing out of existence
- Be 1-2 sentences, max 120 characters
- Match the tone of real MTG flavor text (poetic, ominous, evocative)

Respond with ONLY the flavor text, nothing else.
